SELECT a.athlete_id, a.user_id, a.name, a.gender, a.birthday, a.phone, a.primary_team_id, a.jersey_no, a.position, a.status, a.predicted_adult_height, a.adult_height_algo, a.adult_height_calc_date, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, d.dept_name AS team_name, CASE WHEN a.birthday IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, a.birthday, CURDATE()) END AS age, r.status AS rtp_status, bm.height, bm.weight, bm.body_fat_rate FROM apms_athlete a LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.primary_team_id = d.dept_id
LEFT JOIN apms_rtp_status r ON r.athlete_id = a.athlete_id
LEFT JOIN apms_body_measure bm ON bm.id = ( SELECT m.id FROM apms_body_measure m WHERE m.athlete_id = a.athlete_id ORDER BY m.measure_date DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: ORDER BY a.primary_team_id ASC, a.jersey_no ASC

SELECT r.status AS status, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM apms_athlete a LEFT JOIN apms_rtp_status r ON r.athlete_id = a.athlete_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.primary_team_id = d.dept_id
GROUP BY r.status

SELECT a.athlete_id, a.name, a.gender, a.birthday, a.primary_team_id, a.jersey_no, a.position, a.status, d.dept_name AS team_name FROM apms_athlete a LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.primary_team_id = d.dept_id WHERE a.status = '0' ORDER BY a.primary_team_id ASC, a.birthday ASC, a.athlete_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE apms_athlete SET primary_team_id = #{teamId}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE athlete_id = #{athleteId} AND status = '0'
